Asha (Sec): Security advisory: effective 2026-06-15 we will enforce two new S3 policy changes org-wide: 1) block public access at bucket level by default; 2) require default server-side encryption with a company-managed KMS key (alias/redwood/s3). Action required: owners must update buckets, infra modules, and CI artifacts.
Diego (Cloud): Scope - all AWS accounts and cross-account buckets?
Asha (Sec): All accounts and buckets under our AWS Organization. Cross-account access must use explicit roles and deny public ACLs. Exceptions only for external static websites with approved review (temporary TZ-limited URLs).
Jon (Storage): Quick remediation commands for owners:
```
# block public access
aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket my-bucket --public-access-block-configuration '{"BlockPublicAcls":true,"IgnorePublicAcls":true,"BlockPublicPolicy":true,"RestrictPublicBuckets":true}'
# enable default encryption with KMS
aws s3api put-bucket-encryption --bucket my-bucket --server-side-encryption-configuration '{"Rules":[{"ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault":{"SSEAlgorithm":"aws:kms","KMSMasterKeyID":"alias/redwood/s3"}}]}'
```
Asha (Sec): Please update Terraform/CloudFormation modules and rebuild artifacts. CI that uploads to S3 should set the encryption headers and must not set public ACLs. We've opened ticket SEC-4500 to track migration; paste proof (bucket encryption config + public-access-block output) into the ticket.
sec-bot: Automated scan scheduled: weekly S3 public-access audit + encryption-report. Initial inventory running; results will be posted to SEC-4500 and this channel.
Diego (Cloud): I'll add preventive checks to our CI lint step to fail PRs that set acl=public-read or omit server_side_encryption in templates.
Jon (Storage): I'll create a short runbook and a remediation Lambda to auto-block public ACLs for non-exempt buckets. Will link in SEC-4500.
Asha (Sec): Deadlines: update infra modules + CI by 2026-05-15; complete bucket migration and evidence in SEC-4500 by 2026-06-15. Noncompliant buckets will be auto-updated and owners notified. Ping me for exceptions or help. :lock:
